releases.notes:
## 更新内容

- 修复半自动射击模式射击后点击左键误触发按键配置`ShootToReload`
- 添加射手配置`EnableWeightModifier`，默认不启用枪械重量对移速的影响
- 同步配置`WeightSpeedMultiplier`最小值提高至0
- 添加配件数据`weight`的向后兼容
- 添加配件显示`scopeViewFov`的额外向后兼容

修复重载数据包/资源包时错误地读取客户端侧缓存（已知潜在问题 #40）：
- 修复单人游戏配件修饰缓存未参与服务端侧计算
- 修复单人游戏枪械排序缓存为空
- 修复单人游戏配件可装性缓存取到空枪械排序缓存

数据包：
- 独立乘算操作对齐原版语义，涉及所有`unique_multiplier`/`multiplier`字段
- 现在`unique_multiplier`为0时对应乘算1（之前为0），因此修复了数值偏小的问题
- 未对此专门更改过的旧枪包不受影响

开发者：
- `GunItem`不再重载`IForgeItem#onEntitySwing`为`true`
- 第一人称完全接管动画，第三人称由`InteractKey`取消摆手
- 不影响原行为

# English

- Fixed left-clicking after shooting in semi-auto fire mode accidentally triggering key config `ShootToReload`
- Add shooter config `EnableWeightModifier`, disabling the effect of gun weight on movement speed by default
- Raised the minimum value of sync config `WeightSpeedMultiplier` to 0
- Add backward compatibility for attachment data `weight`
- Add additional backward compatibility for attachment display `scopeViewFov`

Fixed erroneously reading client-side cache when reloading data packs / resource packs (Known potential issue #40):
- Fixed single-player Attachment modifier cache not participating in server-side calculations
- Fixed single-player Gun sort cache being empty
- Fixed single-player Attachment installability cache retrieving empty Gun sort cache

Data pack:
- Align unique multiplier operation with vanilla semantics across all `unique_multiplier`/`multiplier` fields
- A `unique_multiplier` of 0 now corresponds to multiplying by 1 (previously 0), thus fixed values being small
- Legacy gun packs not specifically modified for this remain unaffected

For Developer:
- `GunItem` no longer overrides `IForgeItem#onEntitySwing` to `true`
- First-person animations take over completely, while third-person swing cancellation is handled by `InteractKey`
- Does not affect original behavior

# Release notes

## What's Changed
* Shooter movement speed by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/100


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/compare/26.11.36.1...26.11.37

releases.notes:
## 更新内容

引入静态烘焙和脏子树优化：
- 静态展示与第一人称改用烘焙网格，只在动画改动时重新生成对应部分
- 测试枪械渲染帧时间减少约 74.5%，渲染性能提升约 3.92 倍
- 添加调试键记录渲染测试，在游戏目录生成`customgun-render-profile.txt`
- 添加调试指令`/customgun debug enableStaticBake [bool]`
- 添加调试指令`/customgun debug enableReloadAnimationDebugTest [bool]`

美术：
- 性能主要取决于会动的组带着多少 cube 一起动：跟着动的那部分每帧都要重新生成，越少越省
- 整枪动画务必写在根节点`root`上：根节点的状态特殊处理，不会使整枪重新渲染
- 不同动画尽量复用同一个组：每让一个组动起来，模型就会多分出一部分单独绘制（之后不会合并回去）

1.21.4+：
- 修复内置实体交互过滤标签

1.21.10+：
- 修复内置枪射物穿透方块标签

开发者：
- 修复在 Windows 编译时的中文编码问题

# English

Introduced static baking and dirty subtree optimization:
- Static display and first-person rendering now use baked meshes; only the part changed by animation is regenerated
- Test gun rendering frame time reduced by approximately 74.5%, with rendering performance improved by about 3.92x.
- Add debug key to record render tests, generating `customgun-render-profile.txt` in the game directory.
- Add debug command `/customgun debug enableStaticBake [bool]`.
- Add debug command `/customgun debug enableReloadAnimationDebugTest [bool]`.

For Artist:
- Performance primarily depends on how many cubes move with an animated group: moving parts are regenerated every frame, so fewer is cheaper
- Whole-gun animations must be applied to the root node `root`: the state of the root node is handled specially and will not cause the entire gun to re-render.
- Reuse the same group across animations where possible: Every group you animate splits off another part that is drawn separately (it never merges back)

1.21.4+:
- Fixed built-in entity interaction filter tags.

1.21.10+:
- Fixed built-in projectile pass through block tags.

For Developers:
- Fixed Chinese character encoding issues during compilation on Windows.

# Release notes

## What's Changed
* Render analysis by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/89
* Static bake refactor by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/92
* Dirty subtree render refactor by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/93
* Decouple lighting render refactor by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/94
* Render type merge render refactor by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/95
* Render refactor by @XColorful in https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/pull/96


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/compare/26.11.35.1...26.11.36

配置：

- 默认在瞄准时切换到第一人称视角
- 默认在取消瞄准时恢复视角
- 默认按住射击键时不自动拉栓
- 默认在空仓状态下射击时触发换弹

1.21.6+：
- 修复开光影时瞄准镜准心跟雾重叠
- 修复 26.3 开光影时瞄准镜准心被雾遮挡

26.2+：

网络：
- 更新网络协议版本至`35`，与旧版本无法进行网络连接

# English

- Gun projectile damage cooldown now uses vanilla tag `bypasses_cooldown`
- Rename zoom config from "Zoom" to "zoom"
- Disable mouse scrolling zoom for non multi-view scope
- Cache several sync config on the client side
- Add translation key for the reload command

Config:
- Add key config `AimSwitchToFirstPerson`, `RevertAimPerspective`, `HoldShootPreventBolt`, `ShootToReload`
- Switch to first-person view while aiming by default
- Revert the perspective upon canceling aim by default
- Prevent auto-bolting while holding down the shoot key by default
- Trigger reload when shooting with an empty chamber by default

1.21.6+:
- Fixed scope division blending with fog when shaders are enabled
- Fixed scope division blocked by fog in 26.3 when shaders are enabled

26.2+:
- Fixed gun model text renders black when shaders are enabled (Issue #84)

Network:
- Update network protocol version to `35`, which prevents connections between new and older versions

For Developer:
- Add `ShooterSwitchAimEvent`, code using `CustomEventType` may need to be recompiled

# Release notes

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XColorful/Custom-Gun-Continued/compare/26.10.34.1...26.11.35
